.vpm { font-family: "PP Neue Montreal", Inter, Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(25, 37, 46); box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.2; }
.vpm * { box-sizing: border-box; }
.vpm details { position: relative; }
.vpm summary { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; cursor: pointer; min-height: 44px; list-style: none; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; }
.vpm summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
.vpm summary svg { color: rgb(79, 99, 115); transition: transform 0.15s; }
.vpm details[open] summary svg { transform: rotate(180deg); }
.vpm :focus-visible { outline: rgb(57, 114, 156) solid 2px; outline-offset: 4px; }

.vpm-panel { position: absolute; top: 100%; left: 0px; width: 330px; padding: 10px; background: rgb(255, 255, 255); border: 1px solid rgb(212, 222, 219); box-shadow: rgba(25, 41, 46, 0.082) 0px 12px 30px; z-index: 10; }
.vpm-panel a { display: block; text-decoration: none; color: rgb(28, 41, 46); padding: 18px 16px; }
.vpm-panel a:hover { background: rgb(238, 243, 239); }
.vpm-panel a + a { border-top: 1px solid rgb(227, 233, 229); }
.vpm-panel a > span { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 500; }
.vpm-panel b { font-weight: 400; }
.vpm-panel small { display: block; color: rgb(82, 99, 108); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; margin-top: 7px; }
.vpm-mobile summary { min-height: 44px; width: 100%; justify-content: space-between; }

.vpm-mobile .vpm-panel { position: relative; top: auto; left: auto; width: 100%; margin: 4px 0px 12px; box-shadow: none; border-width: 0px 0px 0px 1px; border-style: none none none solid; border-color: currentcolor currentcolor currentcolor rgb(204, 216, 211); border-image: none; padding: 0px 0px 0px 8px; background: transparent; }
.vpm-mobile .vpm-panel a { padding: 14px 12px; }
.vpm-mobile .vpm-panel a > span { font-size: 16px; }
.vpm-mobile .vpm-panel small { font-size: 13px; }
.vpm * { transition: none !important; }
